pages.text: Frieren's unravelling of Serie's barrier (ep. 21). The non-Euclidean shape in her cupped hands bursts into panes of green glass, then a column of light shoots up from her hands into the dome.

The dome turns to clear, oily glass, bands spread down it until the whole sky is striped violet and green, and after a flash it breaks into crystals that hang in the sky and drift down. Examination barriers only; you must stand inside or beneath one. Needs full mana. K or Escape skips the camera.
